name: Rocket Blast - 1g Cart - Shortcake Dream
description:
Sweet, creamy, and dessert-smooth. The Rocket Blast Shortcake Dream cartridge holds 1 gram of premium oil — a distillate base blended with terpenes — in a universal-fit 510-thread cart that screws right onto any standard battery. Simple, reliable, and made to last.

Shortcake Dream serves up that classic strawberry shortcake flavor: ripe, juicy strawberry layered over sweet cake and whipped-cream notes with a smooth, buttery finish. It's an indulgent, dessert-forward profile made for anyone who likes their sessions sweet and satisfying.

Why you'll love it:

1G total oil — premium distillate blended with terpenes for full flavor
Universal 510-thread fit — works with any standard 510 battery
Signature Shortcake Dream flavor — ripe strawberry with sweet cake and cream notes
Reliable performance — flavorful, even pulls from first to last

Rich flavor and dependable quality in a classic, easy-to-use cartridge. Just attach your battery and enjoy — Rocket Blast Shortcake Dream is ready when you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
